## Security Checklist
Please review and check the following items before submitting:

- [ ] **No Secrets:** Confirmed no API keys, tokens, credentials, or private keys are included in code or commits.
- [ ] **Input Validation & Sanitization:** All user inputs are validated, sanitized, and type-checked where applicable.
- [ ] **Secure Error Handling:** Errors do not expose sensitive internal data or full stack traces.
- [ ] **Least Privilege:** Permissions and roles adhere to the principle of least privilege.
- [ ] **Testing:** Added or updated tests to verify changes and ensure security bounds are maintained.
